results.question: How many AI-enabled devices have been cleared through 510(k)?
results.generated_sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM fda_510k

results.question: How many distinct companies have AI 510(k) clearances?
results.generated_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT company_name) AS n_companies FROM fda_510k

results.question: How many AI devices were cleared in 2023?
results.generated_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM fda_510k WHERE decision_year = 2023

results.question: How many AI clearances went through the Third Party Review Program?
results.generated_sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM fda_510k WHERE third_party

results.question: How many Special 510(k) submissions are there?

results.question: Show all FDA clearances for Aidoc.
results.generated_sql: SELECT regnumber, decision_date, device_trade_name, product_code FROM fda_510k WHERE lower(company_name) = lower('Aidoc') OR lower(company_name) LIKE lower('Aidoc') || ' %' ORDER BY decision_date

results.question: Which companies have the most AI device clearances?
results.generated_sql: SELECT company_name, count(*) AS n FROM fda_510k GROUP BY company_name ORDER BY n DESC, company_name LIMIT 10

results.question: How many clearances does GE Healthcare have?
results.generated_sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM fda_510k WHERE lower(company_name) = lower('GE Healthcare') OR lower(company_name) LIKE lower('GE Healthcare') || ' %'

results.question: How many companies have only ever had one AI clearance?
results.generated_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT company_name FROM fda_510k GROUP BY company_name HAVING count(*) = 1)

results.question: List companies with at least 10 AI clearances.
results.generated_sql: SELECT company_name, count(*) AS n FROM fda_510k GROUP BY company_name HAVING count(*) >= 10 ORDER BY n DESC, company_name

results.question: When did Viz.ai receive its first AI clearance?
results.generated_sql: SELECT min(decision_date) AS first_clearance_date FROM fda_510k WHERE lower(company_name) = lower('Viz.ai') OR lower(company_name) LIKE lower('Viz.ai') || ' %'

results.question: Which companies received their first AI clearance in 2023?
results.generated_sql: SELECT company_name, min(decision_date) AS first_clearance_date FROM fda_510k GROUP BY company_name HAVING year(min(decision_date)) = 2023 ORDER BY first_clearance_date, company_name

results.question: How many companies entered the AI device market each year?
results.generated_sql: WITH firsts AS (SELECT company_name, min(decision_date) AS first_date FROM fda_510k GROUP BY company_name) SELECT year(first_date) AS first_clearance_year, count(*) AS n_companies FROM firsts GROUP BY first_clearance_year ORDER BY first_clearance_year

results.question: Which company was the earliest to get an AI clearance?
results.generated_sql: SELECT company_name, min(decision_date) AS first_clearance FROM fda_510k GROUP BY company_name ORDER BY first_clearance, company_name LIMIT 1

results.question: How many AI devices were cleared annually since 2015?
results.generated_sql: SELECT decision_year, count(*) AS n FROM fda_510k WHERE decision_year >= 2015 GROUP BY decision_year ORDER BY decision_year

results.question: How long does it take from submission to decision, on average?
results.generated_sql: SELECT round(avg(date_diff('day', date_received, decision_date)), 1) AS avg_review_days FROM fda_510k

results.question: Has review time gotten longer over the years?
results.generated_sql: SELECT decision_year, round(avg(date_diff('day', date_received, decision_date)), 1) AS avg_review_days FROM fda_510k GROUP BY decision_year ORDER BY decision_year

results.question: How many AI clearances were there in the last full year of data?

results.question: What medical specialties do AI devices fall under?

results.question: How many AI clearances are in radiology?

results.question: Which product code grew fastest between 2020 and 2025?
results.detail: "Grew fastest" can mean two very different things here: the largest absolute increase in clearances from 2020 to 2025, or the largest percentage increase (which is undefined for product codes with no 2020 clearances — most of the fast risers). Which definition do you want, absolute change in annual clearance count or percentage change restricted to codes with at least one 2020 clearance?
